layout_rules: The featured comment card uses a 1536px wide dark composition and grows vertically with wrapped comment text.
Author, moderator badge, timestamp, and pinned marker share a compact top row with calculated horizontal spacing.
The author avatar is a circular monogram and does not copy a Reddit user avatar.
The body uses a fixed 58px font scale and 72px line height on the 1536px canvas.
The bottom action row is placed after the final wrapped body line with a 55px lower margin.
SVG text is escaped and usernames longer than Reddit's 20 character limit are rejected.
Promo panels remain marketing artwork, not screenshots of a live app.
note: The sample SVG is a design reference for the generated PNG renderer. The comment card uses original icons and an original monogram avatar rather than a pixel perfect Reddit interface reproduction.
